body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes example app action buttons not rendering by merging stack-level `actions[]` into each object’s definition (`objectDef.actions`) after `defineStack()`, aligning with the existing post-processing approach used for `listViews`.

**Changes:**
- Added `mergeActionsIntoObjects()` and applied it after `mergeViewsIntoObjects()` in the root dev config and the Console shared config.
- Introduced new action definitions for Todo and Kitchen Sink, and wired stack-level `actions` into their example configs (plus MSW-Todo inline actions).
- Updated several CRM actions with `list_toolbar`/`bulkEnabled` and added `visible` expressions; added explicit `objectName: 'project_task'` for project task actions.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| objectstack.config.ts | Adds `mergeActionsIntoObjects()` and applies it during merged app assembly so actions appear under `objectDef.actions`. |
| apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts | Mirrors the same action-merge behavior for Console’s shared merged metadata. |
| examples/todo/src/domains/todo/task.actions.ts | Adds Todo task action metadata (locations, visible rules, params, bulk flags). |
| examples/todo/objectstack.config.ts | Wires Todo actions into stack-level `actions`. |
| examples/msw-todo/objectstack.config.ts | Adds inline Task actions and wires them into stack-level `actions`. |
| examples/kitchen-sink/src/objects/showcase.actions.ts | Adds Showcase action metadata (including bulk toolbar actions). |
| examples/kitchen-sink/objectstack.config.ts | Wires Showcase actions into stack-level `actions`. |
| examples/crm/src/actions/project.actions.ts | Adds `objectName` override for `project_task` action merging. |
| examples/crm/src/actions/opportunity.actions.ts | Adds `list_toolbar` + `bulkEnabled` and `visible` expressions for stage-dependent actions. |
| examples/crm/src/actions/contact.actions.ts | Adds bulk toolbar support and a visibility rule for convert action. |
| examples/crm/src/actions/account.actions.ts | Adds bulk toolbar support for assign-owner. |
| ROADMAP.md | Documents the actions-merge milestone. |
</details>

`variant: 'danger'` is not a supported Button/Action variant in this codebase (Shadcn Button variants are `default|destructive|outline|secondary|ghost|link`, and Action components also check for `destructive`). Use `destructive` here so the delete action renders with the intended styling.
```suggestion
    variant: 'destructive' as const,
```

`variant: 'danger'` is not a supported Button/Action variant in this codebase (Shadcn Button variants are `default|destructive|outline|secondary|ghost|link`, and Action components also check for `destructive`). Use `destructive` so this action renders with the intended destructive styling.
```suggestion
    variant: 'destructive' as const,
```
This ROADMAP entry says “Fixes #840”, but the PR description metadata says it fixes #940. Please align the referenced issue number so the changelog/automation links to the correct issue.

`mergeActionsIntoObjects()` is duplicated here and in `apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts`. Consider extracting it to a shared helper module to avoid future drift when the matching/merge logic needs changes.
